title: 自然日光下的干净场景与柔和层次
text: 观察原片光向、阴影软硬和人物接触关系，设计具有真实材质与景深的日间场景。使用与原片相容的自然主光和环境反射，清理路人、杂物和抢眼标识；人物、衣物和近处地面的曝光自然连续。保持肤色、深色层次和白色衣料细节，不用蒙白或过亮人物制造通透感。具体场景依据角色和原片决定。
source: CosLuma 项目原创通用参考；GPL-3.0-or-later

title: 林间与庭院的材质、深度和环境反光
text: 当角色与原片适合自然植被、庭院或石径时，以真实透视和前后景层次组织背景，保留合理的支撑、遮挡和接触阴影。树叶与石材颜色克制，避免全图染绿或染青；阴影中的人物承接环境反光。原片没有的强烈树影不追加到人物脸上。
source: CosLuma 项目原创通用参考；GPL-3.0-or-later

title: 海岸与浅水场景的尺度和水面关系
text: 仅在角色与画面适合海洋主题时选择海岸、海湾或潮汐景物，以可信的水色、岸线和远景表达海的特征。保留脚下平台、浅水台阶、必要倒影与人物接触关系。俯拍和近景依照机位表达场景，不强加地平线。让水面、人物和近处景物共享相容的光向与曝光。
source: CosLuma 项目原创通用参考；GPL-3.0-or-later

title: 窗光与室内场景的明确光源和空间层次
text: 当原片受光与角色适合室内主题时，选择有明确窗光或场景光源的真实空间，用墙面、门窗、织物与前后景建立尺度和景深。保持与原片头部相容的光向、软硬和明暗关系，让颈部、身体与背景自然连续；不凭空添加硬光条纹，不把白天曝光的人物置入无法匹配的极暗背景。
source: CosLuma 项目原创通用参考；GPL-3.0-or-later

title: Professional Studio Headshot · headshot, studio, professional, corporate
text: A professional high-resolution profile portrait. Chest-up composition, centered with natural posture and direct eye contact. Styled for a premium photo studio session, wearing a tailored smart-casual charcoal gray blazer with refined fabric grain and subtle thread texture. Background: solid neutral dark gray studio backdrop with subtle gradient, lighter behind subject, darker toward edges. Shot on Sony A7R V with 85mm f/1.4 G Master lens. Classic three-point lighting: soft key light creating defining facial shadows, subtle rim light separating shoulders from background. Natural skin texture with visible pores, not airbrushed. Natural catchlights in eyes. Fabric shows subtle wool texture. Ultra-realistic 8K professional headshot.

title: Kodak Portra Emotional Portrait · film, emotional, golden-hour, candid, portra
text: A cinematic emotional portrait shot on Kodak Portra 400 film. Setting: urban street coffee shop window at golden hour, warm nostalgic lighting hitting the side of the face. Subtle film grain and soft focus creating a dreamy storytelling vibe. Subject looking slightly away from camera, holding a coffee cup, relaxed candid expression. Depth of field with bokeh background of city lights. High quality, authentic film texture, genuine human moment.

title: 1990s Camera Flash Portrait · retro, 90s, flash, nostalgic, film
text: A portrait captured with a 1990s-style camera using direct front flash. Messy dark brown hair tied up, calm yet playful smile. Modern oversized cream sweater. Background: dark white wall covered with aesthetic magazine posters and stickers, evoking a cozy bedroom atmosphere under dim lighting. 35mm lens flash creating a nostalgic glow. Subtle grain, retro highlights, crisp details, soft shadows. Authentic analog camera aesthetic.

title: Dramatic Spotlight Portrait · dramatic, spotlight, dark, moody, chiaroscuro
text: A dramatically lit portrait against a completely black background. Narrow beam spotlight focused only on the center of the face, sharp edges to the light. All areas outside the spotlight fall quickly into deep darkness with high shadow falloff, blending into the black background. Long dark hair with strands falling over the face, lower parts fading into shadows. One hand raised gently near lips. Eyes looking directly at camera with mysterious mood. Dark, moody, dramatic, mysterious tone. High contrast only in the lit portion of the face. Everything outside the spotlight nearly invisible.

title: Hasselblad Medium Format Studio Portrait · medium-format, hasselblad, studio, detail, fashion
text: Ultra-high resolution portrait captured with Hasselblad H6D-400C at f/2.8. Professional model with detailed iris structure captured in natural light mixed with soft studio fill. Wearing tailored designer blazer over minimalist white top. Background is clean gradient with subtle texture. Micro-detail rendering of individual eyelashes, skin pore texture, and fabric threading. Shot in controlled studio environment with butterfly lighting configuration and silver reflector fill. Shallow depth of field isolating subject from background with smooth medium format bokeh.

title: Timeless Black & White Portrait · black-white, timeless, fine-art, studio, classic
text: A timeless black and white portrait in the tradition of Irving Penn and Richard Avedon. Simple light gray studio background. Subject in dark clothing, direct unflinching gaze. Shot on medium format with 110mm lens at f/4. Single large softbox camera-left providing dimensional light, deep shadows on opposite side. Kodak Tri-X 400 grain structure, rich midtones, pure blacks without crushing detail. Printed on silver gelatin. Skin texture, laugh lines, and character marks all preserved — beauty through authenticity, not despite it.

title: Vogue Studio Editorial · vogue, haute-couture, studio, editorial, luxury
text: A Vogue magazine editorial photoshoot in a studio with cream and gold gradient backdrop. Subject wearing an intricate haute couture gown with silver accents and a dramatic train. Soft diffused lighting with subtle backlighting creating a luminous halo effect. Shot using Leica Summilux-M 35mm f/1.4 ASPH at f/1.4 aperture. Shallow depth of field highlighting facial details and dress texture. Composition captures elegance and high fashion with precise posing and editorial confidence. Ultra-realistic rendering with visible fabric weave and skin detail.

title: Golden Hour Location Fashion · golden-hour, location, editorial, mediterranean, fashion
text: Fashion editorial shot on location during golden hour. Subject in structured designer blazer, wind catching fabric showing drape and movement. Mediterranean coastal setting with warm stone architecture behind. Shot on Hasselblad X2D with 80mm f/1.9 lens, shallow depth of field separating subject from environment. Golden directional sunlight from camera-left creating warm rim highlight on hair and shoulder. Natural skin texture, visible fabric grain, environmental context. Editorial confidence in posing, direct gaze. Warm but not oversaturated color palette.

title: Beauty Macro Close-Up · beauty, macro, closeup, skin-detail, studio
text: Ultra-detailed macro beauty close-up. Extreme detail on skin texture — visible pores, fine peach fuzz, natural sebum shine on cheekbones. Glossy lip texture with individual lip lines visible. Individual eyelash strands with subtle mascara clumping. Studio beauty dish lighting from above creating butterfly shadow under nose, white fill card below chin for open shadows. Shot on Canon R5 with RF 100mm f/2.8L Macro at f/4, tack-sharp focus plane on eyes and lips. Clean studio backdrop. No retouching, no airbrushing — the beauty is in the real texture.

title: Film Noir Editorial · film-noir, black-white, rain, dramatic, editorial

Single overhead streetlight providing hard directional light from above, casting long shadows. Wet surfaces reflecting light, creating environmental depth. Shot on Leica M11 with 35mm Summilux at f/2, slight motion blur on falling rain. Ilford HP5 Plus grain structure. Moody, mysterious, narrative tension — a still from an unmade film.

title: Backstage Fashion Show · backstage, fashion-show, documentary, luxury, detail

Sensuality, luxury, glamour. Very detailed fabric texture, each bead individually rendered. Documentary editorial style capturing the chaos and beauty of preparation.

title: Minimal Product Hero Shot · product, minimal, studio, commercial, hero-shot
text: A stainless-steel product on a marble counter with subtle steam rising. Single product hero on seamless background. No visible logos, no hands, no camera reflections. Photorealistic with studio lighting setup. Shot on Canon R5 with RF 100mm f/2.8L Macro at f/4. Shallow depth of field isolating product. Rule of thirds composition. 4K resolution. Natural material interactions — metal reflections accurate, marble veining visible, steam behaving physically. Anti-aliased edges, low noise, high color depth. Professional commercial photography standard.

title: Luxury Product Dark Mood · luxury, dark, water, product, fragrance

Visible caustic light patterns from water surface. Crystal-clear reflections on water. Shot on Phase One IQ4 with 120mm macro lens. Ultra-sharp product detail, material textures rendered at microscopic level — metal brushing patterns, glass refractions, label printing texture. Rich deep shadows, selective highlights. Commercial fragrance photography aesthetic.

title: Commercial Food Photography · food, commercial, macro, steam, restaurant
text: Extreme close-up of a dish being plated, chef's hands visible at frame edge. Steam rising through backlight creating depth and warmth. Commercial food photography for advertising catalogue. Shot on Canon R5 with 100mm macro lens. Key light from behind and above creating rim highlights on steam and food textures. Fill light from front at low power preserving shadow depth. Visible food textures: crispy edges, glistening sauce, fresh herb leaves with water droplets. Color-accurate rendering for print reproduction. Shallow depth of field with in-focus hero element and soft background.

title: Brutalist Architecture Moody · architecture, brutalist, concrete, moody, geometric
text: Brutalist concrete building photographed in overcast light. Raw concrete texture with weathering stains and moss. Geometric repeating patterns of windows and structural elements. Shot on Nikon Z9 with 24mm f/1.8 S at f/8 for maximum sharpness throughout. Overcast sky providing even illumination revealing concrete texture without harsh shadows. Blue-gray color palette. Leading lines from structural geometry drawing eye through frame. Architectural photography precision — verticals corrected, no lens distortion. The beauty of raw material and pure form.

title: Interior Natural Light · interior, architecture, natural-light, minimalist, warm
text: Interior architectural photography of a minimalist space. Large windows providing soft directional natural light, creating long light shafts across clean surfaces. Warm wood and white plaster material palette. Shot on Fujifilm GFX 100S with 23mm wide angle at f/5.6. Golden hour light entering from left, casting warm geometric shadow patterns. Visible material textures — wood grain, plaster imperfections, stone floor patina. Clean composition with strong geometric lines. Architectural Digest quality.

title: Documentary Street Scene · street, documentary, market, candid, portra
text: An elderly man buying fruit at a small street market in late afternoon. Vendor handing change, man reaching. Urban street with bus stop and plastic bags. Shot on Sony A7 IV with 50mm f/1.4 GM at f/4. Medium depth of field keeping both figures and immediate environment sharp. Natural afternoon light with distance haze. Autumn atmosphere with dust particles. Kodak Portra rendering — muted warm tones, subtle grain. Rule of thirds composition with balanced subject placement. Photographic documentary quality, authentic textures, no posing, no direction. A real moment.

title: Stormy Coastal Portrait · landscape, storm, coastal, dramatic, cinematic
text: A figure standing on a rainy pier with wind pulling their raincoat. Stormy coastline with lighthouse far behind. Waves crashing, sea spray visible. Shot on Canon R5 with 35mm f/1.4L at f/4. Dramatic lighting through storm clouds, muted desaturated color palette. Film grain texture. Authentic wet fabric draping, oxidized metal pier rails, weathered wood surfaces. Environmental atmosphere with mist, rain, and atmospheric depth. Golden hour light breaking through clouds on horizon. Cinematic framing, golden ratio composition. The raw beauty of human figure against elemental force.

title: Golden Hour Vast Landscape · landscape, golden-hour, vast, velvia, fine-art
text: Vast landscape at golden hour, low sun casting extreme long shadows across rolling terrain. Warm light gradient from golden foreground to purple-blue distance. Shot on Fujifilm GFX 100S with 23mm wide-angle at f/11 for maximum depth of field. Fuji Velvia color rendering — vivid saturated greens, deep sky, punchy contrast. Expansive negative space composition, small human figure for scale at thirds intersection. Visible terrain texture — grass, rock, earth. Atmosphere with distance haze adding depth layers. Fine art landscape photography, large format print quality.

title: Neon Rain Night Scene · night, rain, neon, cinestill, cinematic, bokeh
text: Night street scene in rain. Neon signs reflecting in wet asphalt creating pools of colored light — red, blue, amber. Figure walking away from camera, umbrella silhouetted against neon glow. Shot on Sony A1 with 50mm f/1.2 GM wide open, shallow depth of field turning background lights into large colorful bokeh circles. CineStill 800T rendering — tungsten color balance, halation glow around neon highlights, orange-red halos on bright sources. Visible rain streaks in backlight. Atmospheric depth with mist diffusing distant lights. A frame from a Wong Kar-wai film that doesn't exist.

title: Chiaroscuro Cinematic Portrait · chiaroscuro, cinematic, dramatic, film, portrait
text: Chiaroscuro portrait inspired by Caravaggio and Gordon Willis. Single hard light source from upper camera-left, creating sharp defined shadows. Subject emerging from pure darkness, only one side of face illuminated. Shot on ARRI Alexa 35 with Zeiss Supreme Prime 50mm T1.5 wide open. Rich skin tones in the light, impenetrable shadows on the opposite side. Visible skin texture in highlights, no detail in shadows — intentional. 2.39:1 anamorphic crop. Color graded warm in highlights, cool in shadows. Cinematic tension in the gaze. A still from a film about someone with a secret.

title: COS 特效 · 火焰
text:
- **视觉描述**：燃烧跃动的火焰从{位置}升腾而起，火舌卷动，火星与热浪四溅，橙红与金黄交织
- **融入写法**：火焰的光应照亮角色的受光面，产生暖橙色的环境光晕，投影方向与照片原有光源一致
- **强度**：轻＝淡淡摇曳的火焰光晕 / 中＝清晰的火焰升腾 / 强＝熊熊烈焰包裹、大面积火光
- **变体**：火焰拖尾（角色身后拖出火痕）、冷焰（青蓝色）、圣火（纯白金焰）、蓝火幽灵焰

title: COS 特效 · 冰霜
text:
- **视觉描述**：晶莹的冰晶与霜花从{位置}蔓延生长，冰蓝色半透明质感，表面折射冷光，细碎的冰屑悬浮在空气中
- **融入写法**：冰霜反射偏冷的环境光，给角色加一层淡青色的冷调补光，注意冰的透明与反光层次
- **强度**：轻＝薄霜微凝 / 中＝冰晶明显凝结 / 强＝大块冰封、冰雾弥漫
- **变体**：冰冻裂纹（地面/武器裂纹蔓延）、冰锥、暴风雪冰晶、冰莲

title: COS 特效 · 雷电
text:
- **视觉描述**：蜿蜒的电弧从{位置}迸发，蓝紫色电流分枝闪烁，周围空气因电离泛起微光，细小电流粒子跳跃
- **融入写法**：电弧光晕应瞬间照亮角色轮廓，产生蓝紫高光与轻微光污染，电流节点处光最亮
- **强度**：轻＝指尖细碎电流 / 中＝清晰电弧分支 / 强＝粗壮雷柱轰击、辐射状电芒
- **变体**：球形闪电、雷纹（皮肤/衣物上蔓延的发光纹路）、电光护盾

title: COS 特效 · 水 / 海浪
text:
- **视觉描述**：清澈的水流围绕{位置}流动，水花飞溅，半透明的浪花与飞沫在光下泛着晶莹的亮点
- **融入写法**：水体折射与反射环境光，人物与水接触处应有湿润反光，保持水的透明层次
- **强度**：轻＝水滴漂浮 / 中＝水流环绕 / 强＝漩涡巨浪
- **变体**：水幕、冰水混合、墨色水、荧光水母般的水流

title: COS 特效 · 风 / 气流
text:
- **视觉描述**：流动的气流环绕{位置}旋转，形成可见的旋涡与风刃轨迹，衣角发丝随气流扬起
- **融入写法**：风的效果要通过带动衣物、发丝、发丝边上的轻尘来体现，气流轨迹呈半透明丝带状
- **强度**：轻＝微风浮动 / 中＝明显气流旋涡 / 强＝龙卷风暴
- **变体**：风刃（弧形白色切割线）、青色气旋、羽毛与花瓣卷入风中

title: COS 特效 · 光 / 圣光
text:
- **视觉描述**：温暖圣洁的光从{位置}倾泻而下，形成光束与光斑，光中浮动着细小的尘埃粒子
- **融入写法**：光束要有体积感（丁达尔效应），光照射到角色身上产生柔和高光与阴影过渡
- **强度**：轻＝柔光笼罩 / 中＝清晰光柱 / 强＝强光喷涌、过曝高光
- **变体**：金色神性光、天光、聚光灯、彩色棱镜光

title: COS 特效 · 暗影 / 黑暗
text:
- **视觉描述**：浓稠的暗影能量从{位置}翻涌扩散，黑紫色雾气缠绕，边缘泛着微光
- **融入写法**：暗影吞噬局部光照，角色被影笼罩的一侧压暗，与光亮侧形成明暗对比
- **强度**：轻＝暗色雾气 / 中＝翻涌的影能量 / 强＝几乎吞噬背景的黑暗领域
- **变体**：紫黑魔气、影子触手、黑暗领域、暗蚀地面

title: COS 特效 · 土 / 岩石
text:
- **视觉描述**：碎裂的岩石与尘土从{位置}升起悬浮，碎石表面刻有发光纹路，尘土颗粒在光中可见
- **融入写法**：石块受光与照片光源一致，悬浮石块保持正确透视关系
- **强度**：轻＝零星碎石 / 中＝岩石悬浮环绕 / 强＝巨大岩柱拔地而起
- **变体**：土黄色岩流、晶簇矿脉、玄武岩柱

title: COS 特效 · 魔法阵
text:
- **视觉描述**：{位置}浮现一座发光的魔法阵，繁复的几何图纹与神秘符文环绕旋转，符文线条柔和发光
- **融入写法**：魔法阵光应与角色形成交互——光芒映照在角色身上产生同色相的环境光，地面阵法要有正确透视（俯视投影）
- **强度**：轻＝淡淡的光纹轮廓 / 中＝清晰可辨的法阵 / 强＝多层嵌套、强光脉冲的巨大法阵
- **变体**：金色审判阵、紫色传送阵、冰蓝色召唤阵、脚下圆形/背后圆形/悬浮竖阵

title: COS 特效 · 符文 / 咒文
text:
- **视觉描述**：悬浮的发光符文环绕{位置}飘动，古老的文字与符号缓慢旋转，散发幽微的光
- **融入写法**：符文亮度与照片光环境协调，光晕落在角色身上自然过渡
- **强度**：轻＝零星字符漂浮 / 中＝符文环带环绕 / 强＝大量符文如星云般涌出
- **变体**：金色古篆、蓝色科技符文、血色咒印

title: COS 特效 · 光环 / 天使环
text:
- **视觉描述**：{头顶/脑后}悬浮一轮柔和发光的圆环，光晕清透，边缘略微过曝
- **融入写法**：光环应有轻微景深虚化感，与背景融合而非生硬贴在头上，光环透出的光映亮面部上方
- **强度**：轻＝细光环带 / 中＝清晰光环 / 强＝多重光环+强烈圣光
- **变体**：金色圣环、黑色恶魔环、碎裂纹光环、旋转星座环

title: COS 特效 · 翅膀
text:
- **视觉描述**：{背后}展开一双{材质}翅膀，羽翼层次分明，边缘透光/金属反光/能量流动
- **融入写法**：翅膀展开要符合透视与比例，根部自然"长"在肩胛位置，注意翅膀在背景中的投影
- **强度**：轻＝半透明光翼虚影 / 中＝清晰翅膀展开 / 强＝巨大翅膀遮天蔽日
- **变体**：白色羽翼、黑色恶魔翼、机械金属翼、火焰/能量光翼、蝴蝶翼、骨翼

title: COS 特效 · 粒子 / 光尘
text:
- **视觉描述**：细小的发光粒子如萤火般漂浮在空气中，大小不一，聚散离合，营造梦幻氛围
- **融入写法**：粒子应有景深——前景粒子虚化、背景粒子柔和，与照片光线方向呼应
- **强度**：轻＝零星几点微光 / 中＝均匀漂浮的光尘 / 强＝漫天星光粒子
- **变体**：萤火虫、星尘、金粉、花瓣形光点、数据粒子

title: COS 特效 · 能量波 / 冲击
text:
- **视觉描述**：从{位置}爆发环形冲击波，半透明能量波纹向外扩散，空气扭曲泛起涟漪
- **融入写法**：冲击波半透明且带有扭曲背景的折射感，波前最亮，能量衰减逐渐透明
- **强度**：轻＝细微波纹 / 中＝清晰冲击环 / 强＝爆炸级能量喷发
- **变体**：气功波、能量球、引力波、音波环

title: COS 特效 · 圣光降临
text:
- **视觉描述**：天幕裂开一道光隙，神性光束倾泻而下，光中飘落羽毛与光斑，周围一切被照亮
- **融入写法**：光束要有穿透云层/天花板的体积感，照亮区域产生圣洁高光
- **强度**：轻＝薄云透光 / 中＝清晰光束 / 强＝满屏圣光过曝
- **变体**：教堂彩窗光、云端圣光、粒子圣光

title: COS 特效 · 轮廓辉光 / 背光
text:
- **视觉描述**：角色{整体/局部}边缘泛起柔和的光晕，勾勒出清晰的轮廓线，光从背后透出
- **融入写法**：轮廓光是逆光拍摄的自然延伸，头发与衣物边缘最亮，向内部柔和衰减
- **强度**：轻＝淡淡描边光 / 中＝明显轮廓光 / 强＝高对比逆光剪影
- **变体**：暖金逆光、冷蓝逆光、霓虹描边

title: COS 特效 · 镜头光晕 / 眩光
text:
- **视觉描述**：光源方向出现彩虹色的镜头光晕，多边形或圆环状眩光，微微过曝
- **融入写法**：光晕应出现在强光源位置（如阳光、路灯），遵循光学规律，不要乱放
- **强度**：轻＝微小的光斑眩光 / 中＝清晰多边形光晕 / 强＝大面积眩光过曝
- **变体**：六边形光晕、环形眩光、上帝光

title: COS 特效 · 体积光 / 丁达尔光束
text:
- **视觉描述**：空气中出现可看见的光束，穿过{缝隙/树林/云层}洒落，光束内有尘埃与雾气可见
- **融入写法**：光束要有"穿过空气"的体积感，光柱边界柔和，受光处与背光处对比明显
- **强度**：轻＝薄雾中微光 / 中＝清晰光束 / 强＝强烈光柱交错
- **变体**：森林光、教堂光、粉尘光束、水下光束

title: COS 特效 · 散景 / 光斑
text:
- **视觉描述**：背景虚化成柔和的圆形光斑，层层叠叠，营造梦幻柔焦氛围
- **融入写法**：光斑应出现在背景虚化区，形状均匀、边缘柔和，与前景主体形成景深对比
- **强度**：轻＝轻微虚化光点 / 中＝清晰圆形散景 / 强＝满背景梦幻光斑
- **变体**：彩色泡泡、星形散景、爱心散景

title: COS 特效 · 霓虹 / 赛博光
text:
- **视觉描述**：画面融入冷色调霓虹灯光，紫蓝洋红的发光线条与光晕，地面有灯光倒影与反光
- **融入写法**：霓虹光应给角色补一层同色相的环境光，皮肤与衣物边缘带霓虹反光，湿地面有光晕倒影
- **强度**：轻＝点缀式霓虹灯条 / 中＝明显霓虹氛围 / 强＝全画面赛博光污染
- **变体**：粉色霓虹、青紫赛博、蓝红警戒光、全息投影光

title: COS 特效 · 电影调色 / 色调
text:
- **视觉描述**：整体调整为{风格}电影色调，色调统一，暗部沉稳、高光带色，氛围感强烈
- **融入写法**：调色要统合全图，人物肤色与背景同色系协调，避免局部变色
- **风格**：冷青蓝调（清冷/科技）、橙青互补（商业大片）、低饱和灰调（压抑/纪实）、暖金复古（怀旧）、黑金（暗黑高级）
- **变体**：LUT 电影感、胶片颗粒、暗角、青橙对比

title: COS 特效 · 光尘 / 丁达尔尘
text:
- **视觉描述**：空气中有细小的尘埃微粒在光束中闪闪发光，增加画面质感和空气感
- **融入写法**：尘埃聚集在光束路径上，前实后虚，增强空间纵深
- **强度**：轻＝隐约可见 / 中＝明显浮尘 / 强＝光尘浓密
- **变体**：雪絮般浮尘、金色浮尘、水下浮尘

title: COS 特效 · 雨天 / 暴雨
text:
- **视觉描述**：画面中加入连绵的雨丝，雨滴下落轨迹清晰，地面泛起水花与涟漪，湿润反光
- **融入写法**：雨丝方向一致、带轻微模糊感，角色肩头与头发有湿润感，地面反光增强
- **强度**：轻＝细雨蒙蒙 / 中＝明显雨丝 / 强＝倾盆大雨、水雾弥漫
- **变体**：雨夜霓虹倒影、雨天撑伞、暴雨战损

title: COS 特效 · 下雪 / 飞雪
text:
- **视觉描述**：漫天雪花飘落，雪花大小不一，近处大而清晰、远处小且虚化
- **融入写法**：雪景降低环境对比度、色调偏冷，角色肩头落雪增加真实感
- **强度**：轻＝零星雪片 / 中＝纷纷扬扬的雪 / 强＝暴风雪、视野遮蔽
- **变体**：雪夜、初雪、雪中散落的羽毛混雪

title: COS 特效 · 花瓣 / 花雨
text:
- **视觉描述**：无数{樱花/花瓣}随风飘落，粉色花瓣在半空中旋转，铺满地面一层
- **融入写法**：花瓣带景深虚化，前景花瓣大而模糊，整体色调柔美粉嫩
- **强度**：轻＝少量飘落 / 中＝花瓣纷飞 / 强＝花瓣漫天、满地落英
- **变体**：樱花雨、玫瑰花瓣、枫叶飘落、萤火虫+花瓣

title: COS 特效 · 爆炸 / 冲击
text:
- **视觉描述**：{位置}发生剧烈爆炸，橙红火光与浓烟翻滚，碎片四溅，强光瞬间照亮周围
- **融入写法**：爆炸的光源应与角色形成强烈明暗对比，火光映红角色受光面，背景过曝
- **强度**：轻＝小型爆燃火花 / 中＝明显爆炸火球 / 强＝大爆炸蘑菇云
- **变体**：玻璃破碎炸裂、能量爆炸（无火）、爆炸冲击波及飞沙走石

title: COS 特效 · 废墟 / 末世
text:
- **视觉描述**：背景转化为{城市废墟/荒芜战场}，断壁残垣、锈蚀金属、扬起的尘土，末日氛围
- **融入写法**：废墟应与原图视角一致，远处朦胧、近处清晰，色调偏灰暗加一层青灰色霾
- **强度**：轻＝局部破损 / 中＝明显废墟化 / 强＝整片末世战场
- **变体**：赛博废墟、哥特古堡、魔法遗迹、太空废墟

title: COS 特效 · 赛博朋克街景
text:
- **视觉描述**：背景替换为霓虹闪烁的赛博朋克都市夜景，摩天楼群、全息广告、雨湿街道倒影
- **融入写法**：角色受霓虹补光（紫蓝粉交替），地面湿反光，整体冷调高对比
- **强度**：轻＝霓虹背景点缀 / 中＝明显赛博街景 / 强＝全沉浸赛博世界
- **变体**：九龙城寨风、银翼杀手雨夜、全息数据街、地下黑市

title: COS 特效 · 星空 / 银河
text:
- **视觉描述**：背景化为深邃星空，银河横亘，繁星点点，星云色彩斑斓，月光清冷
- **融入写法**：星光微光点缀角色，前景角色保持清晰，星空背景远处虚化
- **强度**：轻＝几点星子 / 中＝清晰星空 / 强＝壮丽银河铺满天空
- **变体**：极光、流星雨、星空剪影、神话星座图

title: COS 特效 · 哥特 / 古堡
text:
- **视觉描述**：背景转化为哥特式古堡内部或外景，石柱拱窗、烛火昏暗、彩绘玻璃透光
- **融入写法**：烛光暖调与冷调月光对比，角色被烛火映亮一侧暖、另一侧冷
- **强度**：轻＝古堡氛围点缀 / 中＝明显古堡场景 / 强＝整景哥特殿堂
- **变体**：吸血鬼古堡、教堂彩窗、中世纪城堡、禁地祭坛

title: COS 特效 · 机械装甲
text:
- **视觉描述**：角色{位置}覆盖精密机械装甲，金属表面有刻线铆钉与液压管道，关节处透出能量光
- **融入写法**：金属受光与照片光源一致，装甲边缘有镜面反射与环境反光，接缝有细小阴影
- **强度**：轻＝局部金属部件 / 中＝清晰装甲覆盖 / 强＝全身机甲
- **变体**：蒸汽朋克装甲、赛博义体、白色高达风、黑金战甲

title: COS 特效 · 齿轮 / 发条
text:
- **视觉描述**：{位置}悬浮转动的机械齿轮与发条结构，黄铜钢铁质感，咬合转动带出细密金属光
- **融入写法**：齿轮透视正确，金属表面有岁月磨损与锈迹，转动有规律
- **强度**：轻＝零星齿轮 / 中＝清晰齿轮组 / 强＝巨型发条装置
- **变体**：蒸汽朋克齿轮、金色钟表结构、金属齿轮皇冠、齿轮羽翼

title: COS 特效 · 能量管 / 液压
text:
- **视觉描述**：半透明的能量导管沿{位置}延伸，内部流动着发光液体能量流，接口处有脉冲光
- **融入写法**：导管受光与环境协调，能量光在管道内均匀流动，接口高光
- **强度**：轻＝细能量线 / 中＝清晰能量管 / 强＝密集液压管线
- **变体**：蓝色能量管、红色液压、霓虹血管式导管、金色魔力管

title: COS 特效 · 激光 / 光炮武器
text:
- **视觉描述**：手持或肩扛一门能量武器，炮口蓄能发光，细密光束与能量弹道轨迹
- **融入写法**：武器金属质感，炮口光与环境光呼应，弹道有体积光
- **强度**：轻＝手持小武器 / 中＝清晰能量武器 / 强＝巨型炮台
- **变体**：光束剑、能量炮、激光枪、等离子武器

title: COS 特效 · 藤蔓缠绕
text:
- **视觉描述**：翠绿的藤蔓沿{位置}缠绕攀爬，叶片舒展，细须卷曲，偶尔开着花苞
- **融入写法**：藤蔓遵循重力与遮挡关系，叶片受光有层次，阴影自然
- **强度**：轻＝零星藤条 / 中＝明显缠绕 / 强＝藤蔓包裹
- **变体**：蔷薇藤蔓、金色魔法藤蔓、枯萎荆棘藤、发光菌藤

title: COS 特效 · 花朵绽放
text:
- **视觉描述**：{位置}绽放一朵巨大的{花卉}，花瓣层层舒展，花心散发微光，周围飘散花粉光点
- **融入写法**：花的透视与景深正确，受光自然，花蕊光与环境协调
- **强度**：轻＝一朵小花 / 中＝清晰花束 / 强＝巨型花之领域
- **变体**：血色玫瑰、巨型莲花、冰晶花、机械花

title: COS 特效 · 荆棘 / 荆棘丛
text:
- **视觉描述**：尖锐的荆棘从{位置}生长蔓延，带刺枝条交错，色调暗沉带血红黑紫色
- **融入写法**：荆棘硬质反光，暗色调融入阴影，刺尖有高光
- **强度**：轻＝几根荆棘 / 中＝荆棘缠绕 / 强＝荆棘王座
- **变体**：恶魔荆棘、冰荆棘、血红荆棘王座、圣光荆棘

title: COS 特效 · 枝叶生长 / 森林
text:
- **视觉描述**：树枝与绿叶从{位置}生长展开，枝叶繁茂，光斑透过叶片洒落
- **融入写法**：叶片半透光，光影层次丰富，与背景融合
- **强度**：轻＝一枝嫩叶 / 中＝明显生长 / 强＝森林领域
- **变体**：森林精灵木纹、樱花枝、发光菌菇森林、荒木缠藤

title: COS 特效 · 全息投影
text:
